cleanup_audit.scope: Single original train shard; all exact copies of its first 1024 held-out question texts excluded. No test programs used.
cleanup_audit.preprocessing: One-to-one deletion of comments and empty lines outside strings; identical AST excluding locations required. No new examples or alternate solutions.
cleanup_audit.unchanged: Docstrings, pass statements, imports, variable names, assignments and all executable AST nodes retained.
cleanup_audit.limitations: Same AST does not preserve source/line-number introspection. Diagnostic execution is restricted and sampled; no accuracy or generation-speed gain is established. This does not prove all source targets correct.

reuse_reason: Same 72k model, optimizer, original data and tokenizer; existing cleanup code and tests unchanged. No new CPU Colab runtime required.
